programs.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programs.desc: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

director: Kait Borsay: Narrator, Charlie Bingham: Director, Octavia Hartland: Producer

programs.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programs.desc: Explore Tasmanian devils’ softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, and enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer. Play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull and learn how Digger the owl soothed conservationist Nigel during his cancer treatment.

director: Kait Borsay: Narrator, Charlie Bingham: Director, Octavia Hartland: Producer

programs.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programs.desc: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

director: Kait Borsay: Narrator, Kirstie McLure: Executive Producer

programs.title: Animals Like Us
programs.desc: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

director: Kirstie McLure: Producer, Kait Borsay: Narrator

programs.title: Animals Like Us
programs.desc: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimp’s pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

director: Kirstie McLure: Producer, Kait Borsay: Narrator

programs.title: Animals Like Us
programs.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness’ flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters’ club.

director: Kirstie McLure: Producer, Kait Borsay: Narrator

programs.title: Animal Senses
programs.desc: Some animals have senses that humans can’t even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

programs.title: Rooted
programs.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programs.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programs.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

programs.title: Surviving the Amazon
programs.desc: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

director: Bernard Rogan, Dan Chambers, Andra Heritage:Producers

programs.title: Surviving the Amazon
programs.desc: It’s not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who’ll risk his life for love.

director: Bernard Rogan, Dan Chambers, Andra Heritage:Producers

programs.title: Surviving the Amazon
programs.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what’s it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

director: Bernard Rogan, Dan Chambers, Andra Heritage:Producers
